les: Hoe 'n vuur begin, en hoe jy veilig bly
kaps_punt: brandstof benodig hitte om hulle aan die brand te gesteek, en lug (suurstof) om die brand proses te onderhou; vure is 'n gevaar in ons gemeenskappe

items.bewering: Droë hout lê op 'n hoop en brand nie vanself nie.
items.blok: Hoe 'n vuur begin
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle' (fuel needs heat to ignite); Wood and Fiber Science, 'Heat Release in Thermally Disintegrating Wood' (wfs.swst.org): self-heating needs conditions where heat cannot escape, not an ordinary heap of dry firewood. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Die energie is reeds in die hout gestoor.
items.blok: Hoe 'n vuur begin
items.bron: University of Washington heating-value handout (courses.washington.edu/mengr430): dry wood releases about 16-21 MJ/kg when burnt; the SA Gr 5 curriculum concept 'Energy is stored in fuels' (NECT Gr 5 Term 3 tracker, as quoted in search results). Strictly the energy belongs to fuel plus oxygen together, but 'stored in the fuel' is the standard curriculum simplification and does not mislead at this level. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Brandstof moet eers warm genoeg word voordat dit aan die brand slaan.
items.blok: Hoe 'n vuur begin
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle'; hseblog.com fire-triangle page: heat is the energy needed to raise the fuel to its ignition temperature. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: 'n Vuurhoutjie, 'n aansteker of 'n vonk gee vir die hout daardie eerste hitte. Daardie eerste hitte steek die vuur net aan.
items.blok: Hoe 'n vuur begin
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle' (heat as the ignition element); combustion explainer (technology.marist.com) and xylenepower.com 'Combustion of wood': a starting energy input is needed, after which the flame's own heat keeps the reaction going. Small pieces light from a small flame; thick pieces need more, but the sentence only says the match supplies the first heat, which is true. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Die hitte wat die hout so aansteek, is die insetenergie.
items.blok: Hoe 'n vuur begin
items.bron: SA Gr 5 NWT assessment material (as quoted in search results) defines input energy for this topic as the energy that must be added to a fuel to make it burn; physically this is the ignition heat. Consistent with the lesson's usage. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Die vuur maak daarna self genoeg hitte om aan te hou brand. Daardie hitte steek die stuk hout langsaan ook aan die brand.
items.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
items.bron: technology.marist.com combustion explainer: once started, the flame's heat sustains the reaction and breaks down more wood into burnable gas; arboristsite.com and xylenepower.com 'Combustion of wood': heat feedback between neighbouring pieces keeps a wood fire going and spreads it. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Die hitte en die lig uit die vuur is die uitsetenergie.
items.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
items.bron: SA Gr 5 curriculum concept (NECT Gr 5 Term 3 tracker, as quoted in search results): 'When we burn these fuels we get useful output energy such as heat and light'; Gr 5 assessment material defines output energy as heat and light obtained from burning fuel. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Byna al daardie hitte en lig kom uit die energie wat in die hout gestoor was. Die res kom van die vuurhoutjie se eerste bietjie hitte.
items.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
items.bron: University of Washington heating-value handout: wood about 16-21 MJ/kg; a whole match is roughly 1-2 kJ (brainbound.blog estimate, weak source, but a match is itself only about a tenth of a gram of wood, which bounds it). So one match holds the energy of roughly 0.1 g of wood, and 'byna al' is correct for any real fire. The direction of the sentence is also right: input heat ends up in the output, it is not multiplied. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Water op 'n houtvuur vat die brandende hout se hitte weg, en die vuur gaan dood.
items.blok: Die vuur maak sy eie hitte
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle': water extinguishes by absorbing heat for the phase change from water to steam; hardhattraining.com: cooling brings the fire below its ignition point. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: 'n Vuur het ook lug nodig om aan die brand te bly. Dit is die suurstof in die lug wat die vuur gebruik.
items.blok: Lug hou die vuur aan die gang
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle': heat, fuel and an oxidizing agent, usually oxygen. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Jy kan self 'n vuur meer lug gee. Blaas op warm kole en die vlamme spring op.
items.blok: Lug hou die vuur aan die gang
items.bron: University of Illinois Physics Van Q&A 'Why does blowing put out a flame?' (van.physics.illinois.edu): blowing on embers increases the rate they burn by getting more oxygen to where it reacts with the carbon; hunter-ed.com prescribed-burn guide: blowing on a smouldering ember increases intensity. The sentence is about coals, not a candle flame, so it does not conflict with blowing out a candle. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: 'n Glas oor 'n brandende kers hou nuwe lug uit. Die vlam word kleiner en gaan dood wanneer daar nie genoeg suurstof oorbly nie.
items.blok: Lug hou die vuur aan die gang
items.bron: STAO 'Candle under glass experiment' (stao.ca) and Indiana Public Media 'A Moment of Science': the candle goes out without using up all the oxygen. The lesson's 'nie genoeg suurstof oorbly nie' is the accurate form and avoids the common 'all the oxygen is used up' error. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: 'n Vuur brand net wanneer brandstof, hitte en suurstof bymekaar is. Vat een van die drie weg en die vuur gaan dood.
items.blok: Al drie tegelyk
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle': a fire can be prevented or extinguished by removing any one of the three elements. The article notes rare oxidizers other than oxygen (fluorine, perchlorates) and the fire-tetrahedron refinement; neither reaches anything a Grade 5 learner meets, so 'net' holds at this level. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Water op 'n houtvuur vat die hitte weg, en 'n glas oor die kers hou die lug weg. Dieselfde drie dinge wys ook hoe 'n mens 'n brand kan keer.
items.blok: Al drie tegelyk
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle': prevention and extinguishing both work by keeping out or removing one element; safelincs.co.uk 'Break the fire triangle'. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Vure is 'n gevaar in ons gemeenskappe. 'n Kers, 'n paraffienlamp of 'n stofie val om en steek 'n gordyn of 'n kombers aan.
items.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
items.bron: News24 (16 April 2013): about a thousand shacks burn down in Gauteng each year, mostly because of candles and paraffin stoves; IOL Weekend Argus (29 July 2023) on Western Cape burn cases; Elitsha News on unsafe paraffin stoves. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: 'n Brand begin ook wanneer iemand 'n vlam of kos op die stoof alleen laat.
items.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
items.bron: Citizen / Bedfordview-Edenvale News (20 September 2015): a Mangolongolo fire traced to a stove left on after cooking; SA emergency services' repeated warnings not to leave stoves and candles unattended (SABC News). Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Klein kinders kry vuurhoutjies of 'n aansteker in die hande en speel daarmee.
items.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
items.bron: IOL Weekend Argus (29 July 2023), Western Cape data: fire deaths counted under 'playing with matches' alongside candle fires and heating devices. No source quantifies it as a share of causes, and the lesson does not claim one. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: 'n Stukkende draad of 'n oorlaaide prop word warm en kan aan die brand slaan.
items.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
items.bron: Fire Industry Association (fia.uk.com), 'Pull the plug on fire risks': when the current drawn exceeds what a socket is designed for, the wiring becomes excessively hot and can cause fire; Essex County Fire and Rescue incident 'Overloaded socket causes bedroom fire' (essex-fire.gov.uk, 14 March 2023). Illegal and faulty connections are also named as a cause in SA settlement fires (SABC News, Sowetan). Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: In elkeen van hierdie gevalle bereik hitte 'n brandstof.
items.blok: Hoe brande in ons gemeenskappe begin
items.bron: Checked against each of the four cases with Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle': flame to curtain or blanket, stove heat to food or oil, match flame to whatever the child holds it to, hot wire to its insulation and nearby material. The summary holds for every case listed. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Die meeste reëls wat 'n brand keer, hou een van die drie dinge weg van die ander twee.
items.blok: Hoe jy 'n brand keer
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle': prevention works by keeping one element out of the mix. This is a framing statement more than a countable fact, and 'die meeste' is the honest quantifier: the same block names its own two exceptions (the stove, where the three are deliberately together, and the overloaded plug, where the rule stops the heat arising). Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Sit 'n kers in 'n swaar houer wat nie maklik omval nie, en hou dit weg van gordyne en beddegoed. Bêre vuurhoutjies en aanstekers hoog op waar klein kinders nie kan bykom nie.
items.blok: Hoe jy 'n brand keer
items.bron: News24 (2013) and ChildSafe Cape Town Safer Candles Project as reported (fallen candles are a main cause of settlement fires); KidsHealth 'Fire safety' (kidshealth.org) on keeping matches and lighters away from children. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Los nooit 'n vlam of kos op die stoof alleen nie. By die stoof is die drie dinge met opset bymekaar. Iemand moet daar wees om 'n klein vuur betyds te stop.
items.blok: Hoe jy 'n brand keer
items.bron: Citizen (2015) Mangolongolo fire from a stove left on; SABC News warnings against unattended stoves; Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle' for the mapping: a stove flame is fuel, heat and air together on purpose. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Moenie te veel proppe by een muurprop insteek nie, want die draad word warm. Daardie reël keer dat die hitte ontstaan.
items.blok: Hoe jy 'n brand keer
items.bron: Fire Industry Association (fia.uk.com): multi-way adaptors still draw through one wall socket, and overloading makes the wiring hot; Which? 'How to avoid overloading your plug sockets'. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Skreeu hard sodat almal in die huis weet daar is 'n brand.
items.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
items.bron: Surrey Fire and Rescue home-safety advice (surreycc.gov.uk): make sure everyone in the house knows about the fire, shout FIRE. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Gaan dadelik by die naaste veilige deur uit en bly buite.
items.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
items.bron: Essex County Fire and Rescue (essex-fire.gov.uk): 'get out, stay out'; Bristol City Council: do not go back inside until the fire service says it is safe; KidsHealth: do not go back in for anything. 'Naaste veilige' is the careful form, since a near exit blocked by fire is not the one to use. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Moenie wegkruip nie en moenie vir speelgoed of klere teruggaan nie.
items.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
items.bron: KidsHealth 'Fire safety' (kidshealth.org): never hide under the bed or in a closet, because firefighters will find you harder; do not go back in for anything. Devon and Somerset Fire: do not delay escape to save valuables. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Rook trek boontoe, dus bly jy laag terwyl jy na buite beweeg.
items.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
items.bron: KidsHealth 'Fire safety': smoke naturally rises, so staying low means you can crawl under most of it; Surrey and Suffolk fire services: crawl low in smoke. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: As jy kan, trek die deur agter jou toe, want dit hou die vuur terug.
items.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
items.bron: Suffolk Fire and Rescue (suffolk.gov.uk): close the door to the fire room and all doors behind you as you leave, to delay the spread of fire and smoke. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: As jou klere brand, staan stil en gaan op die grond lê. Bedek jou gesig met jou hande en rol tot die vlamme dood is.
items.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
items.bron: KidsHealth 'Fire safety': do not run; stop, drop to the ground, cover your face with your hands, and roll, which cuts off the air. The lesson's two items keep that order exactly. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: Laat 'n grootmens dadelik om hulp bel sodra almal buite is.
items.blok: Wat om te doen tydens 'n brand
items.bron: KidsHealth 'Fire safety': do not stay inside even to phone, someone else can make that call from outside; Surrey Fire and Rescue: call once you are outside and safe. True as written. A person may want to know that the guidance also lets a child phone for help herself where no adult is there; the line does not forbid that, but it does not say it either. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: brandstof: Iets wat kan brand en dan sy gestoorde energie afgee.
items.blok: brandstof
items.bron: SA Gr 5 curriculum concept (NECT tracker, as quoted in search results): energy is stored in fuels such as coal, wood, petrol, paraffin, gas and candle wax, and burning them releases it as heat and light. Correct for the burnable fuels this topic covers. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: suurstof: Die gas in die lug wat 'n vuur gebruik om te brand.
items.blok: suurstof
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Fire triangle': the oxidizing agent is usually oxygen from the air. Read alone, the entry does not suggest air is only oxygen; it picks out one gas in the air. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: inset: Die energie wat ingaan om iets te laat werk of gebeur.
items.blok: inset
items.bron: SA Gr 5 NWT assessment material (as quoted in search results): input energy is the energy that must be added to make a fuel burn; the entry generalises that consistently. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: uitset: Al die energie wat uitkom wanneer iets werk of gebeur.
items.blok: uitset
items.bron: SA Gr 5 curriculum concept (NECT tracker, as quoted in search results): output energy such as heat and light from burning fuels. 'Al die' is right, since output includes all the energy that comes out, useful or not. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: paraffienlamp: 'n Lamp wat lig maak deur paraffien in 'n pit te brand.
items.blok: paraffienlamp
items.bron: Wikipedia, 'Kerosene lamp': also called a paraffin lamp; a wick draws the fuel up from a reservoir and it burns at the wick's tip. Pressure lamps with a mantle exist, but the wick lamp is the common household kind. Checked in full this round.

items.bewering: brandveiligheid: Die maniere waarop mense brande keer en veilig bly as een uitbreek.
items.blok: brandveiligheid
items.bron: UK fire and rescue home-safety pages (Surrey, Suffolk) cover both halves: preventing fires and what to do if one breaks out. Checked in full this round.

opsomming: Every claim checked out, the candle-under-a-glass and fire-triangle sentences are worded in their careful, correct forms, and the lesson has no analogies; the only thing worth a person's look is that the last safety line says to let an adult phone for help and does not say a child may phone herself if no adult is there, which is not false.
